name: Health information (declared, not sensor data)
plain: Health data LinkedIn declares on its Play label, with no health sensor access.
meaning: A disability or health related profile field or message can become special category data under privacy law.

android.note: Play label lists Health info as collected (optional)

ios.note: Apple label lists Sensitive Info for some purposes

limits.headline: Can't use your health sensors in LinkedIn; health info is only on the store label
limits.user_action: Nothing. No health permission is asked
can: List health information on its store label as optional
Collect health details you type in yourself, if any
cannot: Open Health Connect data on Android; no permission was seen
Open HealthKit data on iPhone; no capability was seen
See your heart rate, steps or sleep from your phone
limits.differs: Both stores show a label entry. Neither phone shows a sensor permission.

story.what_it_is: Health details an app collects when you type them, not from a health sensor.
story.for_you: You may enter a disability, a health condition or a note about your health in a profile or a message. The app is not reading a sensor, but it is still storing health data about you.
story.for_makers: Even typed health details can count as special category data under privacy law. Makers must handle it with extra care and say so on store privacy labels.

use_cases.example: A professional network lets you list a disability or accommodation need on your profile.
A dating app lets you share health info like a medical condition on your profile.
A support group app stores messages about illness.
A work app collects accessibility needs for events.
A pharmacy app saves your medicines list after you type it.
An ad firm might use a typed condition to target ads, which privacy law limits.
A leak of typed health notes could harm you at work or in life.

risks: No sensor needed to leak it
story.android_note: Declared in the app's data safety form, with no sensor permission involved.
story.ios_note: Declared in the app's privacy label, with no sensor permission involved.

technical_bounds: Declared from member input, not sensors

linkedin.how: Play Data safety lists Health info (optional), race and ethnicity (optional) and sexual orientation (optional). Likely member supplied fields or messages. Source of the health label is not documented.
